scripts.compact: compact compile src/bboard.compact ./src/managed/bboard && compact compile src/auction.compact ./src/managed/auction
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json && mkdir -p dist/managed && (cp -Rf ./src/managed/* ./dist/managed/ 2>/dev/null || true) && (cp ./src/bboard.compact ./dist/ 2>/dev/null || true) && (cp ./src/auction.compact ./dist/ 2>/dev/null || true)
scripts.ci: npm run compact && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test
